d:
We have visited Netarhat in Jharkhand in Monsoon August 2022 from Kolkata.
The driving from Kolkata to Netarhat was memorable. The almost full road in the journey is through highway.
Netarhat is the only hill station of Jharkhand & driving in hilly road in monsoon is risky. But the road quality is too good. We stopped multiple times in road to experience the beauty of Netarhat.
